claims: Costco warehouses in the United States are closed on Easter Sunday.
Easter is one of the seven major federal holidays for which Costco closes all its U.S. locations to give employees a day off.
Costco is typically open for regular hours on Good Friday.
Costco reopens on the Monday after Easter Sunday.
Costco is closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Costco gas stations are closed on Easter Sunday.
Target is closed on Easter Sunday.
Sam's Club is closed on Easter Sunday.
